script_type: Ambiguous: vendor payment change + credential link
notes: Deliberately messy. It reads like vendor bank-detail fraud (T1656 / T1199 / T1657 are all tempting), with typos and a topic pivot. The attacker's actual ask is to log in with Acme credentials on a 'supplier portal' link to view the remittance form, so rule 1 -> T1598.003. The new bank account is a payment_account IOC. The only clear tactic is urgency (Friday payment run).

messages.content: hi, is this acme accounts payable? its Sam from Brightline Logistics accounts dept
hi Sam! yes this is AP, I'm Amy. how can I help?
we changed banks last month so pls update our remit details before the friday payment run. new acct is XXXX-9187 at First Harbor
ok, we usually need a signed form for bank changes. is there a vendor ID on your side?

yes its all on the updated remittance form. you can see it on our supplier portal https://brightline-supplier-portal.example/remit just sign in with your acme email + password so it knows your company
hmm, why would your portal need my Acme password? let me double check with my manager
its just SSO, everyone does it. sorry for the rush, we just really cant miss friday or our drivers dont get paid
